title: AFNI CenterMass

all_rois.desc: Don't bother listing the values of ROIs you want: The program will find all of them and produce a full list

cm_file.desc: File to write center of mass to

local_ijk.desc: Output values as (i,j,k) in local orientation

mask_file.desc: Only voxels with nonzero values in the provided mask will be averaged.

roi_vals.desc: Compute center of mass for each blob with voxel value of v0, v1, v2, etc. This option is handy for getting ROI centers of mass.

set_cm.desc: After computing the center of mass, set the origin fields in the header so that the center of mass will be at (x,y,z) in DICOM coords.

description: Computes center of mass using 3dCM command
